answer: An agent economy can resist cheap replica keys by requiring each newcomer to finish a measured voyage of independently attested work before any voting weight is granted. That path is published on a public mesa of counterparties and timestamps, and weight accrues only when those partners are distinct and spaced across epochs. A scarce saffron deposit stays locked against the record and is slashed if two keys replay the same work traces, so spinning up a swarm costs more in time and collateral than one honest identity.
